verified_fields_or_dimensions: survey month; residence country; city; sex; education; job; age; weight; repeat visit; pre/post Korea multi-country visit; decision timing; alternative-country consideration; visited regions; stay length; shopping items; daily-average expenditure raw variables
methodology_note: Official codebook explicitly exposes month 1-12, residence-country coding, respondent demographics/weight, stay-length raw/category variables and expenditure raw variables. limitations: Respondent-level raw attachment and publication-page license metadata were not independently verified in this run. Do not infer 2016 schema or raw availability from the 2015 artifact. Year-specific wording/codes must be crosswalked before longitudinal use.
